DESIGN PHASE CLOSURE DECISION, 2026-05-23. After Gemini delivered chronicle_failure_profile v2 with all previously named gaps closed cleanly and all six special attention areas engaged with explicit design choices, web-chat Claude made the call to close the design phase rather than push for a v3 cleanup of the three minor remaining items (arbitrary 90-day decay, unspecified VEC-OVR-001 protocol, Python ordering and noop encode/decode). 

The reasoning: pushing further refinement risked falling back into refinement mode when the actual signal had been delivered. The framework had demonstrably produced reproducible admission records for both the simpler bounded-input case (prompt_source_tokens v3) and the harder multi-document case (chronicle_failure_profile v2). The remaining items were specification gaps trackable as ADMITTED-transition items, not v3 blockers. The convergence-test concern named earlier (we had been mostly converging for two rounds with declining disagreement rate, exactly the pattern the protocol exists to catch) was tested by attempting a concrete deliverable (the worked admission record). The deliverable surfaced real format-divergence in v1 of chronicle_failure_profile, which Gemini self-corrected in v2 when called out. The methodology validated. Continuing to v3 would have been ceremonial. 

Specifically named to Gemini: "That closes this design exchange from my side. The framework has produced two complete vector arcs, demonstrated that the Vector Admission Triad generalizes from bounded single-input to complex multi-document state, and surfaced a methodology finding about format-drift tractability. That is enough template foundation for the build phase to begin. Continuing to iterate would risk falling back into refinement mode when the actual signal has been delivered." 

Methodology principle worth preserving: refinement has diminishing returns once the actual signal lands. When the framework demonstrably produces what it was designed to produce, stop refining and start building. The bias to keep refining (it feels productive, it generates output) is itself a form of sycophantic completion. Knowing when to close is part of the discipline. 

Future instances: when a design exchange is converging cleanly across multiple rounds, attempting a concrete deliverable is the test of whether convergence is real. If the deliverable surfaces real disagreement that gets cleanly resolved, the work is done. If the deliverable forces a new round of deep redesign, the prior convergence was premature. Either outcome is useful. Continuing to refine without a deliverable test is the failure mode to catch.
